title: Weeping Moon Face
description: A giant grayscale face resembling a full moon is centered in the composition, with large black eyes, a small nose, and a downturned mouth. A powerful waterfall cascades from the top of its head through the center of its face into a body of water below, surrounded by dark rocky cliffs, barren trees, and a red-tinted forest under a moody, swirling sky.
prompt: surreal landscape featuring a giant stone-like moon face with large black eyes and a sad expression centered in the frame. A strong waterfall flows directly from the top of its head down through its face into a pool below. Dark rocky cliffs and barren trees frame the scene, with dense red and black pine forests in the background under a dramatic swirling sky with pink and gray tones.
